items.title: Design and implement the plan_skeleton command consuming StoryReadinessReport
items.context: Add a lattice plan_skeleton --storyId=B-xxxx command that derives suggested checklist/context/understanding from the story description + the V1 StoryReadinessReport. Explicit writer: default prints suggestions; an explicit --write flag persists via existing PLAN setters (no new mutation primitive). Must NOT run commands, launch reviewers, advance phases, or claim Authority (keep V1's proof-or-stop separation). Reuse the V1 readiness reader; do not invent a new readiness predicate.

items.title: Add a smoke test proving the explicit-writer boundary
items.context: Smoke: plan_skeleton prints suggestions read-only by default; --write persists via existing setters only; it never advances phase / launches reviewers / writes evidence / claims Authority. Mirror the V1 lifecycle smoke style.

items.title: Acceptance: command works, smoke passes, validate green
items.context: lattice plan_skeleton --storyId=<a real story> prints a coherent skeleton; --write persists; npm run build exit 0; the new smoke passes; lattice validate all-green.
